name: Elisabeth Militz, PhD
quote: The team coaching with Jasmine was truly transformative. Jasmine's coaching has helped us go beyond purely performative collaboration and forge genuine connections. We have learned to engage with ourselves and each other on a deeper level — for me, this is a new, fundamentally different, and simply better experience of leading a research team and working together in a team. Instead of focusing solely on concepts and methods, Jasmine managed to bring us into contact with the underlying tensions in our team — not only with our minds, but also with our hearts and bodies. Since coaching with Jasmine, we have been working together in a more liberated, open, and productive way.
